name: cerberus-gate
description: Review final answers using session tools under instructions prohibiting side effects, and route corrections to the main agent.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for Cerberus Gate UI, logs and built-in prompts. Custom review prompts are used as written.

reviewerModel.title: Reviewer model
reviewerModel.description: Both model and effort inherit uses a tool-less session fork. Any explicit value uses the complete investigation loop. Model: inherit, haiku, sonnet, opus, or a model ID.

maxRevisions.title: Maximum corrections
maxRevisions.description: Number of correction prompts per user request (0–10). Review the final correction too; 0 skips all reviews.

reviewTimeoutSeconds.title: Review timeout
reviewTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a review is treated as unverified (1–600).

interimMaxChars.title: Interim report length
interimMaxChars.description: Answers of at most this many characters are shown without review while the main agent's background agents or shells run (0–100000; 0 always reviews).

reviewerEffort.title: Reviewer effort
reviewerEffort.description: Both settings inherit uses fork. Otherwise inherit uses the main answer effort in the complete loop; model support may limit effort.

reviewPrompt.title: Review prompt
reviewPrompt.description: Replace the review criteria (up to 20,000 characters). Empty or whitespace uses the default. Read-only permissions and JSON protocol remain fixed.
